name: Jingji Luo Chen'ai
source:
A story that begins with an incomprehensible incident.
Shi Qian never thought that the world would change drastically while she was sleeping. After losing everything, a world she never imagined was unfolding before her.

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2681060/]Steam[/url]]
